sentences.text: Daniel Okafor introduced himself as a solicitor in the employment team (L5).
The meeting date was Wednesday, September 23rd (L6).
S2 stated that she wrote down information on her phone because she did not know what was needed (L9).
S2 stated she worked for Northgate Logistics Limited (L11).
S2 started working there on March 5th, 2018 (L14).
S2 became a team leader in June 2021 (L16).
The disciplinary meeting lasted forty minutes or less, and the person stated they would inform Aisha in writing (L140).
S2 asked S1 roughly how much money she would get if things went well (L282).
S1 clarified that nothing has been issued, there is no claim in the tribunal yet, and nothing has gone to ACAS, noting they are at the start (L286).
S2 stated that the reference would be the main thing (L285).
S1 stated that it is too early to give a figure regarding potential money, and that it depends on how quickly S2 finds work among other things (L283).
S1 mentioned that a reference can often be negotiated as part of a settlement through ACAS, which lines up with what S2 wanted (L284).
S1 stated that S1 would go through the next steps and put them in a letter (L287).
S1 instructed S2 to email the OH report, Marcus's photo of the sensor, any payslips, and the February email by this Friday, the twenty-fifth (L289).
